items.text: Feature Development: Analyze, design, and implement robust, scalable frontend systems and software modules.
Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional global teams and US clients to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Maintenance & Optimization: Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex frontend bugs to continuously improve system performance.
Technical Standard: Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code while participating in code reviews to elevate team standards.
Frontend Architecture: Proven expertise in at least one modern JavaScript framework (React, Angular, or Vue).
API Integration: Deep familiarity with data communication protocols, specifically RPC (Remote Procedure Calls) or RESTful APIs.
Problem Solving: Strong debugging skills and a systematic approach to troubleshooting complex UI/UX and performance issues.
Communication: Excellent professional English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with US clients and international engineering teams.
Professional Experience: 1+ years of production-level frontend development experience.
Core Fundamentals: Strong mastery of modern JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Styling & UI: Familiarity with modern CSS frameworks or methodologies (e.g., Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Styled Components).
Version Control: Proficiency with Git and modern CI/CD workflows.

description.text:
We are seeking an experienced Frontend Engineer to join our global development team. In this role, you will collaborate directly with elite, cross-border engineering teams and interface with our US-based clients. You will be a core member of the software team, driving frontend development, UI/UX design implementation, system diagnostics, and performance optimization to ensure maximum product stability and scalability.
Key Responsibilities
- Feature Development: Analyze, design, and implement robust, scalable frontend systems and software modules.
- Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional global teams and US clients to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
- Maintenance & Optimization: Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex frontend bugs to continuously improve system performance.
- Technical Standard: Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code while participating in code reviews to elevate team standards.
Required Qualifications
- Frontend Architecture: Proven expertise in at least one modern JavaScript framework (React, Angular, or Vue).
- API Integration: Deep familiarity with data communication protocols, specifically RPC (Remote Procedure Calls) or RESTful APIs.
- Problem Solving: Strong debugging skills and a systematic approach to troubleshooting complex UI/UX and performance issues.
- Communication: Excellent professional English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with US clients and international engineering teams.
Preferred Qualifications
- Professional Experience: 1+ years of production-level frontend development experience.
- Core Fundamentals: Strong mastery of modern JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Styling & UI: Familiarity with modern CSS frameworks or methodologies (e.g., Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Styled Components).
- Version Control: Proficiency with Git and modern CI/CD workflows.
